messages:
maya: Heads-up: dedicated canary p95 jumped ~220ms on model xlarge after merge 3b2a5f (adaptive-slicer + kernel-hint changes). Blocking rollout.
ci-bot: [automated] perf/regression-check failed on canary: p95 +230ms for longseq workload. CI: <https://ci.internal/runs/2391234>
ryan: On it. can you paste perf trace / logs?
maya: Logs below:
```
2026-03-16T01:22:10Z perf
microbatch_assign() +18.3ms
kernel_hint_selection() +7.1ms
kv_cache_lookup miss-rate: 6.8% -> 18.4%
stack: runtime/src/microbatch/assign.cc:124
```
sasha: did a bisect locally, narrowing to PR #1589 (adaptive-slicer tweak). Commands:
```
git bisect start
git bisect bad 3b2a5f
git bisect good 2f9c7a
# bisect ended at 9f7e1ab
```
sasha: Culprit commit 9f7e1ab "reverse lane hints to favor fused kernel". Reverting that locally restores p95 baseline.
luis: That matches profiling: reversed hint order made microbatcher prefer fused/kernel-fused lanes for long sequences even when KV locality low -> increases remote KV lookups and cache thrash.
ryan: Impact on shortseq or infra cost?
sasha: shortseq p50 slightly improved, token cost down ~2%. But dedicated longseq p95 regressed significantly. Customer SLA risk.
maya: Proposal: hold rollout. Options: (A) hot-revert PR; (B) conditionally restore hint order for dedicated/longseq; (C) add heuristic for cache-locality before lane selection. Recommend (B) to limit regression surface.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-345 created and assigned to eng-runtime oncall.
maya: I'll notify PMs & support and draft a customer note.
ryan: Opening revert PR #1622 now, running canary when green.
ci-bot: Canary job queued: <https://ci.internal/jobs/2391234/canary>
sasha: I'll add a longseq+kv-miss perf test to the regression suite and a unit for lane-selection.
luis: Agree. Also add a metric to Console showing lane-selection distribution per model so we can detect this earlier.
maya: Thanks — holding rollout until canary green or PR revert merged. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Incident updated: status = investigating
